ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the recent crackdown on Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including the impact on providers and patients.
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How are providers and patients affected by the crackdown?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and highlight the need for increased oversight and accountability in the Medicaid system.
